rules.expr: (head_lag_p99_slots > 2) and (head_lag_window_samples > 0) and (time() - head_lag_updated_at_seconds <= 2 * head_lag_sample_period_seconds) and (head_lag_updated_at_seconds > 0) and (time() >= head_lag_updated_at_seconds)

annotations.summary: Observed nearest-rank p99 over the trailing hour exceeds two slots
annotations.context: Correlate local alert JSONL slot/context_slot and both head roots with root-diff; roots are not metric labels

rules.expr: (head_lag_slots > 32) and (head_lag_available == 1) and (time() - head_lag_updated_at_seconds <= 2 * head_lag_sample_period_seconds) and (head_lag_updated_at_seconds > 0) and (time() >= head_lag_updated_at_seconds)

annotations.summary: Current head lag exceeds thirty-two slots
annotations.context: Correlate local alert JSONL slot/context_slot and both head roots with root-diff; roots are not metric labels

rules.expr: (head_lag_recovery_slots > head_lag_slots_per_epoch) and (head_lag_recovery_active == 1) and (time() - head_lag_updated_at_seconds <= 2 * head_lag_sample_period_seconds) and (head_lag_updated_at_seconds > 0) and (time() >= head_lag_updated_at_seconds)

annotations.summary: Observed recovery exceeds one epoch; gaps may make exact timing uncertain
